column1: # v3.51 — every skip reason a CI run prints, and what somebody decided
# about it. Enforced by scripts/audit_ci_skips.py, which reads the
# SKIPPED lines an actual run produced rather than grepping the source:
# what skips on a laptop and what skips on a runner are different lists,
# and five versions in a row were lost in that gap.
# Keyed on the reason PATTERN, not the test id, so renaming a test does
#   covered-elsewhere  another lane runs it; the note names which
#   deliberate         it should not run here, and the note says why
#   owner-blocked      needs a person; the note names the ask
#   gap                it should run and does not; the note names what

column3: The full journey needs cached CLIP weights. The weekly real-model lane downloads them and runs `pytest -m slow tests/test_e2e_smoke.py`; the hermetic run must not depend on a download.

The asr extra is funasr plus torchaudio and its weights are a further download, too heavy for every push. The transcription logic itself has 50 tests in test_transcribe.py that do run here; what skips is the end-to-end journey through a real engine.
Synthesises test speech with the macOS speech binary, which a Linux runner does not have and should not fake. It runs on the maintainer's machine, where the engine and its weights already are.
The browser job installs playwright and chromium and runs these four files by name; see tests/test_browser_lane_runs.py, which fails if it stops.
Same lane. Launch failure rather than a missing import; the browser job proves a browser launched before it is allowed to go green.

column3: The check is that the maintainer's own username has not been pasted into a doc. On a build account there is no personal username to leak — the machine that can leak the name is the machine that checks for it.
